inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Seed of the environment's random generator
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

inputs.description: Seed used by the next reset
inputs.name: seed

facts.text: CartpolePyTinyDiffSim is registered as CartpolePyTinyDiffSim-v0 with entry point tds_environments.cartpole_tds_env:CartpolePyTinyDiffSim and max_episode_steps 200
The action space is a one-dimensional Box bounded by +-force_mag, and force_mag is 10
x_threshold is 0.4 and theta_threshold_radians is 12 degrees; the observation space is a four-element Box with high [x_threshold*2, float32 max, theta_threshold*2, float32 max]
step passes action[0] to the wrapped environment and returns its observation with reward 1.0 and the done flag
reset returns the wrapped environment's reset state as the observation
seed masks the seed to 32 bits, seeds the wrapped environment and returns [seed]
The compiled step2 returns the observation in [q0, q1, qd0, qd1] order when COMPATIBILITY is not defined
A reset draws every state value uniformly from -0.05 to 0.05 with std::rand
The seed method calls std::srand(s) for the wrapped environment
The constructor sets action_high_ = 10 and action_low_ = -action_high_
The C++ step clips the action to action_low_ and action_high_
The C++ step sets reward 1 and done when the cart position is beyond +-0.4 or the pole angle is beyond +-12 degrees
The cart has mass 1 and the pole has mass 0.1 with its inertial origin at 0.5 m
The pole is a 1.0 m box with iyy 0.00835

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 seeds the wrapped CartpoleEnv (cartpole_tds_env.py:49-55) and the dynamics are deterministic, so one implementation repeats a trajectory for the same seed and actions; the fake draws the initial state with Python's random.Random while upstream uses C++ std::rand, so one seed gives different trajectories on the two

gaps: analytic cart-pole stand-in: the fake integrates the four state values with the standard cart-pole equations and the URDF masses; it does not run the TDS forward dynamics, the URDF multibody, its contact simulation or the neural-network policy, and it was never compared with the upstream engine
the fake draws the initial state with Python's random.Random while upstream draws it from C++ std::rand: one seed does not repeat the same trajectory on the two implementations
observations are Python lists; upstream returns numpy arrays
the TimeLimit wrapper that gym.make adds for CartpolePyTinyDiffSim-v0 (max_episode_steps 200) is not reproduced: the fake reports terminated only from the environment's own x and theta thresholds
no rendering and no snapshot/restore are offered: the fake has no renderer and the environment exposes no get_state/set_state
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by the 1/60 s timestep only
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step, reset or seed is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
